arxiv-2004-13329.title: Kink-antikink collision in a Lorentz-violating ϕ 4 \phi^{4} model Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2004-13329.creator: Haobo Yan, Yuan Zhong, Yu-Xiao Liu, Kei-ichi Maeda
arxiv-2004-13329.description: Abstract In this work, kink-antikink collision in a two-dimensional Lorentz-violating ϕ 4 \phi^{4} model is considered. It is shown that the Lorentz-violating term in the proposed model does not affect the structure of the linear perturbation spectrum of the standard ϕ 4 \phi^{4} model, and thus there exists only one vibrational mode.

arxiv-2410-13270.title: Quantum Coulomb drag mediated by cotunneling of fluxons and Cooper pairs
arxiv-2410-13270.creator: Andrew G. Semenov, Alex Latyshev, Andrei D. Zaikin
arxiv-2410-13270.description: Abstract We predict two novel quantum drag effects which can occur in macroscopically quantum coherent Josephson circuits. We demonstrate that biasing one resistively shunted Josephson junction by an external current one can induce a non-zero voltage drop across another such junction capacitively coupled to the first one.

arxiv-2503-02707.title: Multilingualism, Transnationality, and K-pop in the Online #StopAsianHate Movement
arxiv-2503-02707.creator: Tessa Masis (they/them), Zhangqi Duan, Weiai Wayne Xu, Ethan Zuckerman, Jane Yeahin Pyo, Brendan O’Connor
arxiv-2503-02707.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tessa Masis (they/them), Zhangqi Duan, Weiai Wayne Xu, Ethan Zuckerman, Jane Yeahin Pyo, Brendan O’Connor. The #StopAsianHate (SAH) movement is a broad social movement against violence targeting Asians and Asian Americans, beginning in 2021 in response to racial discrimination related to COVID-19 and sparking worldwide conversation about anti-Asian hate. However, research on the online SAH movement has focused on English-speaking participants so the spread of the movement outside of the United States is largely unknown.

The X-ray polarization of Sco X-1 was measured for the first time with very high significance by the Imaging X-ray Polarimeter Explorer (IXPE). A polarization degree of 1.0 % ± 0.2 % 1.0\%\pm 0.2\% at a PA of 8 ∘ ± 6 ∘ 8\mbox{${}^{\circ}$}\pm 6\mbox{${}^{\circ}$} at 90% confidence level (CL) in the 2–8 keV energy band is obtained, while the source was in its soft state with short flaring periods.

arxiv-2507-01157.title: Dynamics of a dark soliton in a curved 1D Bose-Einstein condensate
arxiv-2507-01157.creator: Jorge A. G. Attie, Emanuel A. L. Henn
arxiv-2507-01157.description: Abstract We investigate the nonlinear dynamics of dark solitons in a one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate confined to a curved geometry. Using the Gross-Pitaevskii equation in curvilinear coordinates and a perturbative expansion in the local curvature, we derive a set of coupled evolution equations for the soliton velocity and the curvature.

arxiv-2511-17674.title: Person Recognition in Aerial Surveillance: A Decade Survey
arxiv-2511-17674.creator: K. Nguyen, F. Liu, C. Fookes, S. Sridharan, X. Liu, A. Ross
arxiv-2511-17674.description: Abstract The rapid emergence of airborne platforms and imaging sensors is enabling new forms of aerial surveillance due to their unprecedented advantages in scale, mobility, deployment, and covert observation capabilities. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of 150+ papers over the last 10 years of human-centric aerial surveillance tasks from a computer vision and machine learning perspective.

pmc-11496712.description: Moral injury has emerged as a construct of interest in healthcare workers’ (HCW) occupational stress and health. We conducted one of the first multidisciplinary, longitudinal studies evaluating the relationship between exposure to potentially morally injurious events (PMIEs), burnout, and turnover intentions. HCWs (N = 473) completed surveys in May of 2020 (T1) and again in May of 2021 (T2).

pmc-13000528.creator: Janice Zitoun, Jannik Dippel, Ina Pahl, Magali Barbaroux, Armin Hauk
pmc-13000528.description: The use of recycled plastics in the pharmaceutical industry raises safety questions, especially with regards to leaching substances that could compromise patient safety. pmc-13681411.title: Elevated glucose in kidney organoids induces tissue-intrinsic inflammation driving epithelial detachment
pmc-13681411.creator: Giulia Spennati, Nicole Vo, Mary C Regier, Heather H Ward, Vivek Das, Anil Karihaloo, Benjamin S Freedman
